# Circle Co-Founder Sean Neville Steps Down as Co-CEO
## Sean Neville, co-founder of Circle, is stepping down as co-CEO six years after founding the crypto trading and payments startup with Jeremy Allaire.
By [Nikhilesh De](https://www.coindesk.com/author/nikhilesh-de)
Updated Sep 13, 2021, 7:46 a.m. EDT Published Dec 4, 2019, 7:46 p.m. EST

...

# Circle Founder Is Billionaire as Crypto Firm Jumps After IPO
[Circle Internet Group Inc.](https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/CRCL:US) co-founder Jeremy Allaire saw his fortune surge to more than $1.7 billion Thursday after the company’s stock almost tripled in its first day of trading.
